name: app-pearl-card-management-dashboard-on-white-monitor
title: Frosted grey card-management dashboard with a large platinum card, dot-matrix charts and serif figures
whatItIs: A white monitor showing a translucent grey dashboard: tile sidebar with a black active tile, a Platinum card carousel with a large pearly card, stat strips with sparklines, dot-matrix and hairline bar charts, spending categories and a Pro upsell card.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; monochrome pearl and serif numbers feel like a private bank.
techniques: Centre a large pearl card as the hero.
Draw charts as dot matrices and hairlines.
Use serif for numbers and sans for labels.
Highlight the active nav tile in black.

vocabulary.definition: A chart drawn with a grid of dots.
A payment card with an iridescent pale finish.
A black nav tile marking the current page.
A promo tile for a paid plan.
